locator: 28.16-20, with John 20.21-23 and Lumen gentium III §§18-20 for the mandate's scope
goal: The bridge STMT-BRIDGE-CHRISTS-CHURCH-FOUNDED-BY-GOD is now derived (result CATHOLICISM-BRIDGE-DIVINE-FOUNDING-FROM-ATTESTED-MANDATE) from four open premises: STMT-RESURRECTION-CONFIRMS-JESUS-MANDATE (claim on Acts 17.31), STMT-GOD-CONFIRMS-ONLY-TRUTH (supported by Dei Filius ch. 3 para. 1), STMT-MANDATE-COVERS-JESUS-FOUNDING-WITH-TEACHING (supported by Matthew 28.18-20) and STMT-ENVOY-FOUNDING-IS-GODS-FOUNDING (supported by John 13.20). Next obligation, the decisive fork: defend or refine the scope premise, i.e. that the attested mandate covers Jesus' founding of a visible authoritative society with a teaching commission, and justify its universal reach over every society in the bridge's antecedent (the map from the commissioned eleven to a founded society; Lumen gentium §23 particular vs universal Church), without silently broadening Founded. Record the rival 'ratification of the message, not of an institution' as an alternative with its own source. Secondary: further witnesses for attestation (Acts 2.22-36, Romans 1.4) and a source analysing envoy agency beyond reception (Lumen gentium III §§18-20, Aquinas on mission). Do not use Dei Filius ch. 3 para. 5's direct assertion as a premise. See docs/founding-authorization-source.md.
reason: The bare bridge has been replaced by four typed, sourced-undefended premises; each is necessary (omission models) and they are jointly satisfiable. The scope premise carries the contested content and its universal scope over societies is unsourced.
